scope: Research-only browser fixture; no candidate full application built and no production change.
proposal: A single-byte Windows-1252 HTML envelope could use more raw-script symbols than ASCII. No savings measurement or full candidate equality claim is made.
reasons: WHATWG HTML requires the actual document encoding and declarations to be UTF-8.
A supported HTTP transport charset overrides a meta declaration. A UTF-8 server header corrupts the tested high-byte payload before the JavaScript decoder can recover it.

sources.finding: Actual document encoding must be UTF-8; meta charset must identify UTF-8.
Supported transport-layer encoding precedes the meta prescan.
